description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDecorator class, which provides methods to set related Employee and License entities by their identifiers and to retrieve formatted license issue and expiry dates. It serves as a decorator/enhancement for the EmployeeLicense entity within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional methods for EmployeeLicense entity, including setting associated Employee and License entities by IDs and retrieving formatted license dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLicense entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with the license based on employee number.

methods.name: setLicenseByLicenseId
methods.description: Sets the License entity associated with the license based on license ID.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the license issued date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Retrieves the license expiry date formatted as a string.
